Rules:
Normal sudoku rules apply.
Each colour represents a different number.
The numbers outside the grid are X-sums.
(If n represents the first number in the row/column the X-sum is the sum of the first n numbers. For e.g. a 6 as the first number means you sum the first 6 numbers in the row/column to get the X-sum.)
The X-sums are shown as coloured squares with each square being a single number. For e.g. a 3 in a green box next to a 4 in a red box would represent an X-sum of 34. Single boxes are single digit X-sums.
The X-sums read left to right and top to bottom.
